Stack.description: Lays its children out in a column (the default) or a row. The usual root of a widget.

Grid.description: Lays its children out in equal columns, wrapping onto new rows — a wall of card tiles.

Divider.description: A thin horizontal rule between two parts of a widget.

Panel.description: A bordered section with a small title — groups a chart or a few rows under a heading, as the deck editor's stats band does.

Heading.description: A heading. Level 1 is the largest; widgets usually want 2 or 3.

Text.description: A line of text. `dim` for secondary words, `accent` for money, `up`/`down` for a rise or a fall, `mono` for figures.

ManaText.description: Text with Magic symbols drawn as icons: a mana cost (`{2}{R}{R}`) or rules text (`{T}: Add {G}.`).

Price.description: An amount of money in the reader's marketplace currency, written the app's way. `null` draws an em dash — a price nobody quotes is not zero.

Hint.description: Shows `text` as the app's tooltip when its children are hovered or focused — an explanation that does not fit on the widget.

Figures.description: Big numbers with a label each — totals, counts, values. A numeric `value` with `money: true` is written in the reader's currency. `fill` spreads them over the whole widget at the largest size that fits.

Bars.description: Horizontal bars comparing values — a breakdown by rarity, colour or set. Each bar is drawn against the largest value. `money` writes values in the reader's currency.

RowList.description: A list of Row children, laid out in as many columns as the widget is wide. Use `repeat` on it to draw one Row per item of a list in state.

Row.description: One line of a RowList: a name, a dim caption under it, a value on the right (`delta` tints it as a rise or a fall), an optional rarity gem or set symbol before it, and an optional progress track (0–1) under it. Pressable when its `press` event is bound.

Message.description: A sentence in place of the widget's content — an empty state (`No decks yet.`) or a failure.

Footer.description: A one-line footer under the content: a summary (`3 decks · 2 complete`), with `said` as a quieter tail.

PriceChart.description: A line of money over time — a card's price or a collection's value. `day` is Unix seconds, oldest first; `value` is in the reader's currency. `summary` describes the line in words for screen readers.

ColumnChart.description: Vertical columns of card counts, each count on its column and its word under it — a mana curve, cards per type, per colour. A screen reader hears `<count> cards <said>` (`said`: `at mana value 2`). `mana: true` draws the words as circled numerals, the deck editor's curve. `height` in px (default 120).

PriceHistogram.description: How a list of prices spreads, as a histogram in the reader's currency — the app bins them. `unit` names what one value is (`cards`). `marked` draws a line at one value with `markedLabel` over it. `summary` describes the spread in words for screen readers.

CardArt.description: A card's picture, by its printing's Scryfall id (`cardId`). `face` 1 is a double-faced card's back. `finish: foil` draws the foil sheen.

CardTile.description: A card as the app's walls draw it: its picture, and its set, number and rarity under it, with an optional price. Pressable when its `press` event is bound — usually to `openCard`.

RarityGem.description: A printing's rarity as a coloured gem (`common`, `uncommon`, `rare`, `mythic`).

FinishMark.description: A copy's finish as the app's glyph — sparkles for foil, a gem for etched.

SetSymbol.description: A set's expansion symbol, by its code (`mh3`, `lea`).

CountTag.description: A small count badge, as drawn over card art (`4`). `title` says the count in words (`4 copies`).

OwnedBadge.description: Whether the reader owns a card — a check with the count when `owned` is above 0, a heart when `wishlisted`, nothing otherwise. Drawn over a card's art or beside its name.

GameChangerMark.description: The Commander Game Changer mark, for a card on that list (it counts toward a deck's bracket).

Button.description: A button. Bind its `press` event to an action (`openView`, `setState` to switch what the widget shows).

TextInput.description: A one-line text box. Bind `value` with `$bindState` to a path of the widget's own state — e.g. a filter its rows' `visible` conditions read.

Select.description: A dropdown of options. Bind `value` with `$bindState` to the widget's own state.

Switch.description: An on/off switch. Bind `checked` with `$bindState` to the widget's own state.

Combobox.description: A dropdown with a search box that narrows its options as the reader types — for a long list (sets, decks, tags). Bind `value` with `$bindState`.

MultiSelect.description: A dropdown that stays open while the reader ticks several options. `triggerLabel` is what the closed box says (`Colours`). Bind `selected` (an array of values) with `$bindState`.

Segmented.description: A row of two to five segments, exactly one pressed — a short choice always in view (`Week`, `Month`, `Year`). Bind `value` with `$bindState`.

RadioGroup.description: Radio buttons, one per line, each with an optional dim `hint` under it — a choice that needs a sentence of explanation. Bind `value` with `$bindState`.

ToggleChip.description: A filter chip that is on or off — the Search page's chips. Several in a horizontal Stack make a filter row. `hint` expands a short label (`NM` → `Near mint`). Bind `pressed` with `$bindState`.

NumberStepper.description: A whole number with minus and plus buttons — how many rows to show, a threshold. Bind `value` with `$bindState`.

FieldGroup.description: A small dim caption over a run of controls, named for a screen reader — how a widget's settings group theirs (`Size`, `Show`).

ChoiceChips.description: A captioned row of small chips, exactly one pressed — how a widget's settings offer a pick (`Comfortable`/`Compact`). Wraps onto more lines; quieter than Segmented. Bind `value` with `$bindState`.

Checkbox.description: One line of words with a checkbox at its far end, the words dim while it is off — a widget's `Show` settings. Bind `checked` with `$bindState`.

Checklist.description: A captioned list of Checkbox lines, one per option — which of several things to show. Bind `selected` (the ticked values) with `$bindState`.

CompactStepper.description: A small bordered box: the label in capitals, `−`, the number, `+` — a widget's `Wide`/`Tall` settings. Smaller than NumberStepper and not typeable. Bind `value` with `$bindState`.

Picker.description: A captioned, compact multi-select — how a widget's settings pick decks, folders or wishlists. Each option may carry a dim `hint` (a deck's format). `triggerLabel` says how many are ticked (`2 decks`, or `None chosen`); searchable past eight options. Bind `selected` with `$bindState`.

CardSearch.description: A search box over the reader's card database that adds printings to a list, each removable — the Price movers widget's card picker. The one input that reads data of its own (the card search). Bind `cards` with `$bindState`; `max` caps the list (default 100).

PriceRange.description: Two price boxes and a slider bounding a price in the reader's currency — the Search page's price filter. `null` is open-ended. Bind `min` and `max` with `$bindState`, and read them in `visible` conditions (`lte`/`gte`).

openCard.description: Open a printing's card details, by its Scryfall id.

openDeck.description: Open a deck in the deck editor, by its id.

openFolder.description: Open a collection or wishlist folder, by its id.

openView.description: Go to one of the app's pages.

showSet.description: Show every card of a set in the Search page, by the set's code.

openPriceHistory.description: Open a printing's price history chart for one finish.

openPrintings.description: Open the dialog of every printing of a card, marking the one `cardId` names. `oracleId` is the card's Oracle id; `name` captions the dialog.

searchText.description: Go to the Search page showing what `text` finds — a card's name, or the search box's own syntax (`t:creature otag:ramp`).

showInCollection.description: Go to the Collection page filtered by `query`, in the search box's syntax (`!"Lightning Bolt" e:lea`).

revealCard.description: Go to the Collection or Wishlist folder a card is filed in (`folderId` null: the cards filed in no folder), filtered by a `query` naming it.

openDeckFolder.description: Go to the Decks page standing in one deck folder.

openReview.description: Go to the Collection or Wishlist showing only the rows flagged for review.

openSettings.description: Go to Settings with one of its panels in view.

goldfish.description: Open a deck and deal a solo practice game of it (goldfishing), on the deck as built. Desktop only.

refresh.description: Read the widget's data again now. It already refreshes whenever the reader's data changes, so this is for an explicit Refresh button.

saveSettings.description: Keep the widget's settings: the state under `path` (`/settings`) is stored with the widget and is that path's state when it is drawn again. Bind settings inputs under that path and give the settings face a Save button pressing this.

formatPrice.description: Money in the reader's marketplace currency: `{ value: number | null }` → `$2.18` / `2,18 €`; null → em dash.

formatNumber.description: A count with thousands separators: `{ value: number }` → `12,480`.

formatPercent.description: A ratio as a whole percentage: `{ value: number }` where 0.25 → `25%`; null → em dash.

formatDate.description: A day in words: `{ seconds: number }` (Unix seconds) → `4 Jul 2026`.
